import pathlib,json,hashlib,time,sys
V=pathlib.Path('/home/holden/mckernel-work/host-preparation/current-host-pair-205-compatibility-20261019-1/n3-variant');B=pathlib.Path('/home/holden/mckernel-work/host-preparation/current-host-pair-205-compatibility-20261019-1/native-packet-1')
basebytes=(B/'machine-base.json').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(basebytes).hexdigest()==sys.argv[1];base=json.loads(basebytes)
snapshotbytes=(V/'root-live-preflight-2.json').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(snapshotbytes).hexdigest()==sys.argv[2];snapshot=json.loads(snapshotbytes)
assert snapshot['status']=='PASS_LIVE_PREEXECUTION_SNAPSHOT' and 0<=time.time()-snapshot['time_epoch']<=60 and snapshot['parent_identity']==base['parent_identity']
assert base['execution_count']==1 and base['runtime_release'] is False and base['fresh_live_preflight'] is None
assert base['terminal_cleanup_and_common_shared_release']['status']=='PASS' and snapshot['terminal_acceptance']=={k:base['exclusive_queue_predecessor'][k] for k in ['path','sha256']}
base.update(status='PASS_EXECUTION_RELEASE',runtime_release=True,fresh_live_preflight={'path':str(V/'root-live-preflight-2.json'),'sha256':sys.argv[2],'bytes':len(snapshotbytes)})
raw=(json.dumps(base,indent=2)+'\n').encode()
with (B/'execution-release.json').open('xb') as f:f.write(raw)
print(json.dumps({'path':str(B/'execution-release.json'),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(raw)}),flush=True)
